## Crystal structure position

```{r,crystal}

cx = 28.5045
cy = 6.877
cz = 59.213

```

## Read data

```{r,autodock_data}

pdb <- readLines("~/Protein_Comparison_workflows/prep_1J3K_5_200.pdbqt")
hetatm <- pdb[grep("^(ATOM|HETATM)", pdb)]
hetatm <- strsplit(hetatm," ")
hetatm[[1]][which(hetatm[[1]]!="")]
hetatm <- lapply(hetatm,function(x) { x[which(x!="")]  } )
hetatm_df <- do.call(rbind.data.frame, hetatm)
colnames(hetatm_df) <- paste("col",1:12)
```



Extract numerical coordinates (col6-8).
Data converted to numerical matrix

```{r,extract_coords}

mx <- apply(hetatm_df[,6:8],2,as.numeric)

str(mx)
summary(mx)

```

## Define ligand box

```{r,lig_box}

min_x <- min(mx[,1])
max_x <- max(mx[,1])
min_y <- min(mx[,2])
max_y <- max(mx[,2])
min_z <- min(mx[,3])
max_z <- max(mx[,3])

```

Prediction ligand position.

```{r,pred}

px <- ( min_x + max_x ) / 2
py <- ( min_y + max_y ) / 2
pz <- ( min_z + max_z ) / 2
```

## Calc diff

```{r,diff}

dx <- abs(cx - px)
dy <- abs(cy - py)
dz <- abs(cz - pz)

```

## 3d hypotenuse

```{r,hypot}

hyp <- sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2 + dz^2)

```

## Define a function

```{r,dist_function}

cxyz <- c(28.5045, 6.877, 59.213)

model_ligand_dist <- function(cxyz, pdbqt_file) {
  pdb <- readLines(pdbqt_file)

  atoms <- pdb[grep("^(ATOM|HETATM)", pdb)]

  if (length(atoms) == 0) {
    stop(paste("No ATOM or HETATM lines found in:", pdbqt_file))
  }

x <- as.numeric(substr(atoms, 31, 38))
y <- as.numeric(substr(atoms, 39, 46))
z <- as.numeric(substr(atoms, 47, 54))

px <- mean(range(x, na.rm = TRUE))
py <- mean(range(y, na.rm = TRUE))
pz <- mean(range(z, na.rm = TRUE))

  dx <- abs(cxyz[1] - px)
  dy <- abs(cxyz[2] - py)
  dz <- abs(cxyz[3] - pz)

  hyp <- sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2 + dz^2)

  return(hyp)
}

```

Test the function.

```{r,functest}

model_ligand_dist(cxyz,"~/Protein_Comparison_workflows/prep_1J3K_5_200.pdbqt")

```

Run for all pdbqt files

```{r runall, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}

# All config docking output files
myfiles <- list.files(
  path = "~/Protein_Comparison_workflows",
  pattern = "^prep_1J3K_(10|15|20|25|30|40|50|60|70)_[0-9]+\\.pdbqt$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

# Stop if files are not found
if (length(myfiles) == 0) {
  stop("No config docking files found in ~/Protein_Comparison_workflows")
}

# Calculate distance for every docking file
distance <- vapply(
  myfiles,
  function(f) model_ligand_dist(cxyz, f),
  numeric(1)
)

# Use short file names
names(distance) <- basename(myfiles)

# Create data frame
plot_df <- data.frame(
  file = names(distance),
  distance = as.numeric(distance),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Extract box size from file name
plot_df$box <- sub(
  "^prep_1J3K_(10|15|20|25|30|40|50|60|70)_[0-9]+\\.pdbqt$",
  "\\1",
  plot_df$file
)

# Extract seed from file name
plot_df$seed <- as.numeric(
  sub(
    "^prep_1J3K_(10|15|20|25|30|40|50|60|70)_([0-9]+)\\.pdbqt$",
    "\\2",
    plot_df$file
  )
)

# Arrange box size order
plot_df$box <- factor(
  plot_df$box,
  levels = c("10", "15", "20", "25", "30", "40", "50", "60", "70")
)

# Arrange by box and seed
plot_df <- plot_df[order(plot_df$box, plot_df$seed), ]

# Extract top-pose Vina free energy from each PDBQT file
extract_vina_energy <- function(pdbqt_file) {

  lines <- readLines(pdbqt_file, warn = FALSE)

  vina_line <- grep(
    "^REMARK VINA RESULT:",
    lines,
    value = TRUE
  )

  if (length(vina_line) == 0) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  # Extract only the binding affinity value
  as.numeric(
    sub(
      "^REMARK VINA RESULT:[[:space:]]*([-0-9.]+).*",
      "\\1",
      vina_line[1]
    )
  )
}

# Extract free energy for every docking file
energy_named <- vapply(
  myfiles,
  extract_vina_energy,
  numeric(1)
)

# Match energies to the correct file names
names(energy_named) <- basename(myfiles)

plot_df$free_energy <- as.numeric(
  energy_named[plot_df$file]
)

print(head(plot_df))

print(range(plot_df$free_energy, na.rm = TRUE))

# Print calculated distances and free energy
print(
  plot_df[, c(
    "file",
    "box",
    "seed",
    "distance",
    "free_energy"
  )]
)

# Summary statistics: mean, median, SD, min, max
summary_stats <- aggregate(
  distance ~ box,
  data = plot_df,
  function(x) c(
    Mean = mean(x),
    Median = median(x),
    SD = sd(x),
    Min = min(x),
    Max = max(x)
  )
)

print(summary_stats)

# Create distance list by grid box
dist_list <- split(
  plot_df$distance,
  plot_df$box,
  drop = TRUE
)

# Boxplot
boxplot(
  dist_list,
  xlab = "Grid Box Size",
  ylab = "Docking Distance (Å)",
  main = "Docking Distance by Grid Box Size\nExhaustiveness = 12",
  col = "white",
  border = "black"
)
```

```{r beeswarm_boxplot, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}

if (!requireNamespace("beeswarm", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Install the beeswarm package first by running: install.packages('beeswarm')")
}

# Use the existing plot_df created in the runall chunk
# This preserves file, box, seed, distance and free_energy

dist_list <- split(
  plot_df$distance,
  plot_df$box,
  drop = TRUE
)

boxplot(
  dist_list,
  xlab = "Grid box size",
  ylab = "Docking distance (Å)",
  main = "Docking Distance by Grid Box Size\nExhaustiveness = 12",
  col = "white",
  border = "black"
)

beeswarm::beeswarm(
  dist_list,
  add = TRUE,
  pch = 19,
  cex = 1,
  col = "darkgray"
)

```



```{r free_energy_vs_distance, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}

# Confirm that free energy is available
if (!"free_energy" %in% names(plot_df)) {
  stop("The free_energy column is missing from plot_df")
}

# Keep only complete results
scatter_df <- plot_df[
  complete.cases(plot_df$distance, plot_df$free_energy),
]

if (nrow(scatter_df) == 0) {
  stop("No complete distance and free-energy values were found")
}

# Scatter plot
plot(
  scatter_df$distance,
  scatter_df$free_energy,
  pch = 19,
  xlab = "Docking distance (Å)",
  ylab = "Vina predicted binding affinity (kcal/mol)",
  main = "Docking Distance vs Vina Binding Affinity"
)

# Linear regression line
fit <- lm(
  free_energy ~ distance,
  data = scatter_df
)

abline(
  fit,
  lwd = 2
)

# Pearson correlation
cor_value <- cor(
  scatter_df$distance,
  scatter_df$free_energy,
  method = "pearson"
)

legend(
  "topright",
  legend = paste0(
    "Pearson r = ",
    round(cor_value, 3)
  ),
  bty = "n"
)

```
